article.title: Sanction for issue of notice.
article.content: The specified authority for the purposes of sections 280 and 281 shall be the Additional Commissioner or the Additional Director or the Joint Commissioner or the Joint Director.
article.html:
284Sanction for issue of notice.

Section 284 · Chapter XVI · A.—Procedure for assessment · page 345 of the Act

The specified authority for the purposes of sections 280 and 281 shall be the Additional Commissioner or the Additional Director or the Joint Commissioner or the Joint Director.
